description:
Build the import and reference graph for TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Rust, Go, Java and Kotlin. format: json, dot or mermaid.
Use when: you want module structure or what a subtree depends on. Narrow with relative_path, depth, languages.
Avoid when: you need usages of one symbol (project_symbol_references) or the impact of an edit (project_change_impact).
Output: nodes[], edges[] {from, to, type, confidence}, external[], unresolved[], stats, truncated. dot and mermaid return data.graph.

format.description: Output format (default json). dot/mermaid return data.graph.

include_external.description: 1 aggregates npm/pip/node package nodes in external[]. Default 0.

max_edges.description: Max edges kept; more sets truncated (default 2000).

relative_path.description: Limit the walk to this subtree (default: the workspace root).
